description: This file defines a Bootstrap plugin called scrollspy, which manages updating navigation based on scroll position. It includes class definitions, plugin registration, and data-API initialization.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Class managing scrollspy behavior, tracking scroll position, and updating active navigation links.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates target offsets based on current DOM positions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles scroll events to activate the appropriate navigation link based on scroll position.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a specific target, updating the active class on navigation elements.
